result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.to_directed()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Convert the graph to a directed graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11577-L11651){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.to_directed() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a new graph with the same nodes but directed edges. If the graph is already directed, returns a new copy. For undirected graphs, creates both directions (u->v and v->u) for each edge. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new directed Graph with the same nodes and bidirectional edges. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Convert an undirected graph to directed: ::: {#cfd5fda1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec undirected = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) directed = undirected.to_directed() # Returns True directed.is_directed() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: ::: {#69b07987 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 4 (A->B, B->A, B->C, C->B) directed.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: Create directed graph for flow analysis: ::: {#a40a3ab7 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Undirected road network roads = ec.Graph(directed=False) roads.add_node(label="A") roads.add_node(label="B") roads.add_node(label="C") roads.add_edge("A", "B", weight=5) roads.add_edge("B", "C", weight=3) # Directed for traffic flow (both directions) traffic = roads.to_directed() # Now can analyze: traffic from A to C vs C to A ``` ::: Use with algorithms requiring directed graphs: ::: {#7a873b51 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_node(label="X") g.add_node(label="Y") g.add_node(label="Z") g.add_edge("X", "Y") g.add_edge("Y", "Z") # Convert for topological sort or cycle detection g_dir = g.to_directed() cycles = g_dir.get_cycles() ``` :::
